description: QGroundControl is open in Fly View showing a connected simulated ArduPilot copter. The agent must navigate to the vehicle parameter settings and change the WPNAV_SPEED parameter (waypoint navigation speed) from its default value of 500 cm/s to 800 cm/s. To do this: (1) Click the Q icon at the top-left of the toolbar to open the navigation menu, (2) Click 'Vehicle Configuration', (3) Click 'Parameters' in the left sidebar, (4) Find 'WPNAV_SPEED' by scrolling to the WP category or using the search box, (5) Click on the parameter to edit it, (6) Change the value to 800, (7) Click Save/OK to confirm the change. The parameter change will be sent to the simulated vehicle.
